_about: Rules that write the short introductory note at the top of a waterbody's panel (`waterbody`) and of a group of waterbodies: a micro-watershed, a tehsil or a district (`unit`). For each kind the first `main` rule whose `when` holds gives the opening sentence; every `add` rule whose `when` holds appends its sentence, in order. `when` uses the expression language of the other knowledge files; placeholders in braces are filled from the fields listed in `_fields` (numbers are rounded: whole numbers as they are, others to one decimal). The notes are written by the page from the same data and community answers as the rest of the panel, so they change when answers are applied.

waterbody.variables: every waterbody variable in variables.json, by id (years_wet, first_wet_year, k_mean, kr_mean, krz_mean, retention_kr, retention_krz, k_early, k_late, late_to_early, drought_fill_ratio, zoi_ci_mean, ...); missing values are null
waterbody.type, type_label, in_scope: type id after community answers, its label in lower case, and whether the type is assessed
waterbody.status, status_label: r (holds water regularly), x (rarely), n (new since 2022), d (never wet); and its label in lower case
waterbody.area_ha, stream_order, n_years: area in ha, Strahler stream order, years in the series (8)
waterbody.weeks_mean, weeks_early, weeks_late, wee: weeks of water a year (17.3 x the sum of the seasonal shares / 100): mean over all years, over 2017-2020, over 2021-2024, and late minus early
waterbody.n_roles, roles_text, role_top_label, rol: roles at 0.5 or more (count and labels), and the strongest role with its value (0-1)
waterbody.n_stress, stress_text, n_severe, n_opp,: observed stresses that are present after answers (count and up to three labels, strongest first), how many are severe, and the same for opportunities
waterbody.n_works, works_text: recorded interventions on this waterbody (count, and type with years)
waterbody.fp_new, fp_year_label, fp_lining, fp_sum: farm and headwater ponds only (impact assessment, knowledge/impact/farmponds.json): whether it is a new pond assessed for its effect on cropping, its first wet year, and its lined/unlined class from the water after it first held water ('lined', 'unlined', 'uncertain' or empty) with the summer water behind it (% of area, % of years)

unit.unit_label, unit_label_cap: 'this micro-watershed', '<name> tehsil' or '<name> district', and the same with a capital letter
unit.n, n_scope, area_ha: waterbodies in the unit, those of an assessed type, and their total area in ha
unit.type1_label, type1_n, type1_pct, type2_l: the two most common types (label in lower-case plural, count, share of all waterbodies in %), and up to four types as text
unit.pct_regular, pct_rarely, n_recent: share of assessed waterbodies that hold water regularly or rarely (%), and recent ponds (new since 2022)
unit.weeks_median, n_summer, pct_summer: median weeks of water a year among assessed waterbodies, and how many (and what share, %) usually still hold water in summer (mean summer water 30% or more)
unit.role_label, role_pct: the role most often at 0.5 or more, and the share of assessed waterbodies where it is (%)
unit.stress1_label, stress1_pct, stress_text,: the most common observed stress (label in lower case, share of waterbodies where it applies that have it, %), up to three such stresses at 10% or more as text, and how many stresses reach 10%
unit.opp_label, opp_pct: the most common opportunity and its share (%)

main.text: A {type_label} of {area_ha} ha. Waterbodies of this type are outside the atlas's scope: they are shown for context and not assessed.
A recent pond: a {type_label} of {area_ha} ha that first held water in {first_wet_year} and has held water every year since.
A {type_label} of {area_ha} ha that held no water in any of the {n_years} years.
A {type_label} of {area_ha} ha that held water in only {years_wet} of the {n_years} years, so rules that read change over the years do not apply to it.
A {type_label} of {area_ha} ha that held water in {years_wet} of the {n_years} years, about {weeks_mean} weeks a year on average.

add.text: It usually still holds water in summer.

add.when: status in ['r', 'n'] and krz_mean < 30 and kr_mean >= 30
add.text: It usually holds water into the rabi season and dries up before summer.
It holds water mainly during the monsoon.
It has held water longer in recent years: about {weeks_late} weeks a year in 2021-2024 against {weeks_early} in 2017-2020.
It has held water for less time in recent years: about {weeks_late} weeks a year in 2021-2024 against {weeks_early} in 2017-2020.
Its water is most likely used for {roles_text}.
No use stands out; the strongest sign is {role_top_label}.
Likely stresses: {stress_text} ({n_severe} severe).
Likely stresses: {stress_text}.
No observed stress is flagged.
Opportunity: {opp_text}.
Recorded intervention: {works_text}; its impact is assessed separately.
Its water looks like a lined pond's: it held water in summer in {fp_summer_years}% of the years since it first filled, over {fp_summer_area}% of its area on average.
Its water looks like an unlined pond's: it is usually dry by summer ({fp_summer_area}% of its area holds summer water), so it mainly stores monsoon water and recharges groundwater.
It first held water in {fp_year_label}, so its effect on cropping around it is assessed as a new farm pond.

main.text: No waterbodies of 0.05 ha or more are mapped in {unit_label}.
{unit_label_cap} has {n} waterbodies, none of a type the atlas assesses: mostly {type1_label}.

{pct_summer}% usually still hold water in summer.
Few hold water into summer ({pct_summer}%).
{n_recent} recent ponds first held water in 2022 or later.
The most common likely use is {role_label} ({role_pct}% of assessed waterbodies).
The most common stresses are {stress_text}.
The most common stress is {stress_text}.
No observed stress affects 10% or more of the waterbodies where it applies.
Opportunity: {opp_label} ({opp_pct}%).
{n_works} have a recorded intervention.
